types.Card: string, two characters: rank 2-9 T J Q K A then suit c d h s
types.Evaluation: {score:number,category:Category,ranks:number[],name:string}; higher score wins, equal scores tie; ranks are 0 (two) to 12 (ace), a five-high straight is [3]

errors: RangeError: fewer than five or more than seven cards, or a code that is not a card

compare.returns: number (positive when a beats b, negative when b beats a, zero for a tie)

winners.returns: {ids:string[],evaluations:Record<string,Evaluation>} (every contender holding the best hand, in contender order)

combinationSize.returns: number (ranks that make the combination; the rest of an evaluation's ranks are kickers)

patternCards.returns: Card[] (the pair, the trips, the flush ... without kickers)

describe.returns: string (English name, for example Full house, kings full of fours)

codes.returns: CardCodes (the card-deck codes this ranking reads)

createHandRanking.returns: HandRanking (defaults to the standard fifty-two card codes)
